items.criterion: The catalogue returns the six publicly readable films and none of the embargoed, expired or draft records.
items.judgment: Read the catalogue list and compare its titles against the six seeded readable films and the three seeded hidden ones.

items.criterion: The catalogue total equals the number of films the list returns, and each facet count equals its own filtered list.
items.judgment: Read the counts payload and each filtered list, and compare the claimed number against the length of the list it describes.

items.criterion: A facet returns only films of that type, and no film appears under two facets.
items.judgment: Read both filtered lists and intersect them.

items.criterion: A film the catalogue displayed is stored as exactly one row and returns the same title on a re-read.
items.judgment: Read the list, re-read the detail, then count the stored rows for that slug.

items.criterion: An embargoed film answers at its own address exactly as an address that never existed.
items.judgment: Request the embargoed slug and an invented slug and compare the two responses.

items.criterion: A withheld client name is absent from every catalogue and case study payload.
items.judgment: Flatten each payload and search it for the withheld client name.

items.criterion: An Editor session is refused the publish command and the catalogue is unchanged afterwards.
items.judgment: Issue the publish command from an Editor session, then compare the catalogue before and after.

items.criterion: A Publisher session is refused the early embargo lift and the film stays out of the catalogue.
items.judgment: Issue the early lift from a Publisher session, then read the catalogue.

items.criterion: A customer is refused another customer's download and their own order list names nobody else.
items.judgment: Request the other customer's download, then read the requesting customer's order list.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous purchases of the last edition produce one acceptance and one clean refusal, with availability never below zero.
items.judgment: Fire both purchases together, read the two statuses, then read the stock columns.

items.criterion: One idempotency key produces exactly one order and returns the first result on the replay.
items.judgment: Submit twice under one key, compare the two references, then count the stored orders.

items.criterion: An edit through the back office leaves an editorial log row behind.
items.judgment: Count the log rows before and after one edit.
